title: Full picture for every customer
problem: Only the demo customer showed tickets, coupons and messages, and those were made up.
now: Every customer shows their real tickets, store credit, loyalty progress, offers used, messages sent, next meeting and an Insights card.
steps: Open a customer who has a support ticket
See Support tickets and Insights on Overview
Open Orders for store credit and offers used
Open Messages & activity for messages sent
notes: Where: Customers › All customers › a customer (/customer-crm)
